title: AmPm's debut album 'Traveling Without Moving'
htmlContent:
The Tokyo-based duo, AmPm, known for their unique electronic music, is releasing their highly anticipated debut album, 'Traveling Without Moving,' on July 14th through Avex Entertainment. The album comprises ten tracks that promise to take listeners on an unforgettable sonic journey through Tokyo, Jakarta, Amsterdam, and New York City.

 

'Traveling Without Moving' embodies the spirit of adventure and the essence of exploration and personal reflections on traveling. Through their mesmerizing melodies and thought-provoking lyrics, AmPm and their ten featured vocalists from the UK, Singapore, and Japan, including Lilly Ahlberg and RAENE, delve deep into the emotions, memories, and impressions associated with these cosmopolitan hubs.

Each track serves as a vivid vignette, painting a sonic tapestry that captures the bustling streets, hidden alleys, and soulful essence of each city. The album's meticulously crafted beats blend seamlessly with captivating vocals, delivering an immersive experience that engages the senses and sparks the imagination.

AmPm shares, "We drew inspiration from our own journeys to create an album that embodies the excitement, beauty, and diversity of the world's great metropolises. 'Traveling Without Moving' is our invitation to embark on an auditory adventure like no other."

AmPm's debut album promises to leave an indelible mark on the electronic music landscape. With its infectious energy, innovative production, and genre-blending soundscapes, 'Traveling Without Moving' will surely captivate listeners and transport them to the heart of each city explored.

‘Traveling Without Moving’ track listing:

1. Interlude - Tokyo

2. Tokyo on My Mind feat. Nathan Hartono 

3. Streets of Tokyo feat. Michael Kaneko

4. Fall Back feat. MoMo

5. Interlude - Jakarta

6. Wake Up feat. Lilly Ahlberg

7. Haven feat. Hana Hope

8. Holding You Back feat. Kenya Fujita 

9. Interlude – Amsterdam 

10. Cinnamon Chai

11. Sweet Escape feat. RAENE

12. Amsterdam Maybe feat. SHIMA 

13. Interlude – New York City -

14. Good Life feat. mimiko

15. West Side 

16. Stranger Things 

‘Traveling Without Moving’ is released on July 14.
